findings.issue: Task 7 implementation hint says 'check saveFile(at:) in WorkspaceManager for current NSSavePanel convention', but saveFile(at:) at L1218 writes directly via String.write(to:) with no NSSavePanel at all. There is no NSSavePanel precedent to mirror in WorkspaceManager.
findings.fix: Remove or correct the hint. Implementor should look at AppKit NSSavePanel documentation or other macOS apps in the project for the panel-open pattern. No existing mirror exists in WorkspaceManager.

findings.issue: Task 7 step 3 says 'existing conformance lives on EditorView.Coordinator per code-research §6' but provides 'verify after Task 6 lands' caveat. The actual conformance is already at EditorView.swift L319 (extension EditorView.Coordinator: WebViewBridgeDelegate) in the current codebase. This is not a problem but the uncertainty language could confuse the implementor.
findings.fix: Minor clarification only — the extension point at L319 is confirmed in the current codebase. No code change needed.

findings.issue: Task 8 implementation hint disabled-predicate omits the extra check present in code-research.md §11: 'workspaceManager.rootNode?.url.hasDirectoryPath != true'. The task's simpler predicate (rootNode == nil || !hasMarkdownFiles) is functionally sufficient but the code-research §11 includes it to guard against a single-file workspace where rootNode is non-nil but not a directory.
findings.fix: Consider adding the hasDirectoryPath guard to the disabled predicate to fully match the code-research §11 spec, or explicitly document in the task that single-file workspaces are handled via hasMarkdownFiles returning false.

findings.issue: Task 9 expects to hand-trace SSE parser against Tests/Fixtures/sse-anthropic-sample.txt and marker parser against Tests/Fixtures/marker-cases/*.md. These fixture files are committed in Task 1 and Task 5 respectively — but Task 9 has depends_on: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8]. If any of Tasks 1 or 5 are not yet complete when Task 9 runs, the fixtures will be absent and hand-trace will be impossible. The dependency declaration is correct (both 1 and 5 are listed), but the task body does not mention a fallback if fixture files are unexpectedly absent.
findings.fix: Add an explicit check at the start of Task 9: verify both fixture paths exist before starting hand-trace; abort with finding if absent. No structural change needed since dependencies already cover this.
